reading: The sketch mocks up a Figma-style design tool page: a dark top toolbar, a left 'LAYERS' panel, a central 'Desktop' canvas frame containing a gradient hero block, a selected black pill button (with its selection outline, corner handles, and a blue dimension badge), a collaborator cursor label 'Noor', a body-copy text line, and a right-hand properties inspector panel with FRAME/CORNER RADIUS/FILL/STROKE/EFFECTS sections.
